# Variant Calling {#variant-calling}

Variant calling was performed at different analytical resolutions according to the sequencing platform and the capabilities of each tool. For 10x Genomics datasets, variants were identified at the pooled, cell-type, or single-cell level, whereas Smart-seq2 datasets were analyzed at the individual-cell level. Tool-specific preprocessing, calling parameters, filtering procedures, and output processing steps are documented in the following sections.

| Analysis level | Tools |
|---|---|
| 10x pooled | GATK; FreeBayes; SAMtools; VarScan2; Strelka2; Monopogen; scSNV; cellsnp-lite |
| 10x cell type | SComatic; cellsnp-lite; SAMtools; FreeBayes; VarScan2; Strelka2; Monovar |
| 10x single cell | Monopogen; scSNV; scAllele; cellsnp-lite |
| Smart-seq2 single cell | GATK; SAMtools; FreeBayes; VarScan2; Strelka2; cellsnp-lite; scAllele; Monovar |


## GATK

GATK HaplotypeCaller detects SNVs and indels using local haplotype assembly and probabilistic genotyping.

The workflow included:
  
- Preprocessing: Apply `SplitNCigarReads` to RNA-seq BAM files.
- Variant calling and filtering

**Reference:** [GATK (Genome Research, 2010)](https://gatk.broadinstitute.org/)


  
<details>
<summary>10x pooled level (germline)</summary>
  
**calling:**

```{bash,eval=FALSE}
REF="/home/tantingting/scmut/ref/bwa_ref/genome.fa"
IN_DIR="/mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut/bam/2_melanoma_scRNA"
OUT_DIR="/mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut/vcf/2_melanoma_scRNA/hap_pool"

JAVA_OPTS="-Xmx24g"
THREADS=16

mkdir -p "$OUT_DIR"

# Iterate over all sample directories
for sample_path in "${IN_DIR}"/*_SRR*; do

    [[ -d "$sample_path" ]] || continue

    sample=$(basename "$sample_path")

    # Input Cell Ranger BAM
    BAM="${sample_path}/outs/possorted_genome_bam.bam"
    [[ -f "$BAM" ]] || continue

    # Output files
    SAMPLE_OUT="${OUT_DIR}/${sample}"
    mkdir -p "$SAMPLE_OUT"

    SPLIT_BAM="${SAMPLE_OUT}/${sample}.split.bam"
    VCF="${SAMPLE_OUT}/${sample}.vcf.gz"

    echo "Processing: $sample"

    # Step 1: SplitNCigarReads
    if [[ ! -f "$SPLIT_BAM" ]]; then
        gatk --java-options "$JAVA_OPTS" SplitNCigarReads \
            -R "$REF" \
            -I "$BAM" \
            -O "$SPLIT_BAM" \
            --create-output-bam-index true || continue
    fi

    # Step 2: HaplotypeCaller
    gatk --java-options "$JAVA_OPTS" HaplotypeCaller \
        -R "$REF" \
        -I "$SPLIT_BAM" \
        -O "$VCF" \
        --native-pair-hmm-threads "$THREADS" \
        --standard-min-confidence-threshold-for-calling 30.0

done
```

**filtering:**

```{bash,eval=FALSE}
SC_BASE=$1
REF=/home/tantingting/scmut/ref/bwa_ref/genome.fa
chr_list="chr1,chr2,chr3,chr4,chr5,chr6,chr7,chr8,chr9,chr10,chr11,chr12,chr13,chr14,chr15,chr16,chr17,chr18,chr19,chr20,chr21,chr22,chrX,chrY,chrM"

echo "======================================"
echo "Input SC directory: ${SC_BASE}"
echo "======================================"
mkdir -p ${SC_BASE}/filter

for SAMPLE_DIR in "${SC_BASE}"/*; do

	[[ $(basename "$SAMPLE_DIR") == "filter" ]] && continue

    [ -d "${SAMPLE_DIR}" ] || continue

    sample=$(basename "${SAMPLE_DIR}")
    raw_vcf="${SAMPLE_DIR}/${sample}.vcf.gz"
	

    pass_vcf="${SC_BASE}/filter/${sample}_PASS.vcf.gz"

    if [[ ! -f "$raw_vcf" ]]; then
        echo "[WARN] Skip $sample: VCF not found"
        continue
    fi

    if [[ -f "$pass_vcf" && -f "${pass_vcf}.tbi" ]]; then
        echo "[SKIP FILTER] $sample"
        echo "[INFO] Kept sites: $(bcftools view -H "$pass_vcf" | wc -l)"
        continue
    fi

    echo "[FILTER] $sample"

    tmp_dir="${SAMPLE_DIR}/tmp_filter"
    mkdir -p "$tmp_dir"

    norm_vcf="${tmp_dir}/${sample}.norm.vcf.gz"

    #######################
    # Step 1: chr filter + normalize
    #######################
    bcftools view -r "$chr_list" "$raw_vcf" -Oz -o "${tmp_dir}/${sample}.chr.vcf.gz"
    bcftools norm -f "$REF" -m -both "${tmp_dir}/${sample}.chr.vcf.gz" -Oz -o "$norm_vcf"
    tabix -f -p vcf "$norm_vcf"

    #######################
    # Step 2: SNP / INDEL split
    #######################
    snp_vcf="${tmp_dir}/snp.vcf.gz"
    indel_vcf="${tmp_dir}/indel.vcf.gz"

    gatk SelectVariants -R "$REF" -V "$norm_vcf" -select-type SNP -O "$snp_vcf"
    gatk SelectVariants -R "$REF" -V "$norm_vcf" -select-type INDEL -O "$indel_vcf"

    #######################
    # Step 3: filtering
    #######################
    snp_f="${tmp_dir}/snp.f.vcf.gz"
    indel_f="${tmp_dir}/indel.f.vcf.gz"

    gatk VariantFiltration -R "$REF" -V "$snp_vcf" \
        -filter "QD < 2.0" --filter-name "QD2" \
        -filter "QUAL < 30.0" --filter-name "QUAL30" \
        -filter "SOR > 3.0" --filter-name "SOR3" \
        -filter "FS > 60.0" --filter-name "FS60" \
        -filter "MQ < 40.0" --filter-name "MQ40" \
        -filter "(vc.hasAttribute('MQRankSum') && MQRankSum < -12.5)" --filter-name "MQRS12.5" \
        -filter "(vc.hasAttribute('ReadPosRankSum') && ReadPosRankSum < -8.0)" --filter-name "RPRS8" \
        -O "$snp_f"

    gatk VariantFiltration -R "$REF" -V "$indel_vcf" \
        -filter "QD < 2.0" --filter-name "QD2" \
        -filter "QUAL < 30.0" --filter-name "QUAL30" \
        -filter "FS > 200.0" --filter-name "FS200" \
        -filter "(vc.hasAttribute('ReadPosRankSum') && ReadPosRankSum < -20.0)" --filter-name "RPRS20" \
        -O "$indel_f"

    #######################
    # Step 4: PASS + DP filter
    #######################
    snp_pass="${tmp_dir}/snp.pass.vcf.gz"
    indel_pass="${tmp_dir}/indel.pass.vcf.gz"

    bcftools view -f PASS -i 'FMT/DP[0]>10' "$snp_f" -Oz -o "$snp_pass"
    tabix -f -p vcf "$snp_pass"

    bcftools view -f PASS -i 'FMT/DP[0]>15' "$indel_f" -Oz -o "$indel_pass"
    tabix -f -p vcf "$indel_pass"

    #######################
    # Step 5: merge + final chr filter + output
    #######################
    merge_vcf="${tmp_dir}/merge.vcf.gz"

    bcftools concat -a "$snp_pass" "$indel_pass" -Oz -o "$merge_vcf"
	bcftools sort "$merge_vcf" -Oz -o "$pass_vcf"
	tabix -f -p vcf "$pass_vcf"

    rm -rf "$tmp_dir"

    echo "[INFO] Final VCF: $pass_vcf"
    echo "[INFO] Kept sites: $(bcftools view -H "$pass_vcf" | wc -l)"

done

echo "======================================"
echo "ALL DONE"
echo "======================================"
```


</details>

only for dataset1

```{bash,eval=FALSE}
export PATH=/home/tantingting/scmut/tools:$PATH
REF_FA=/home/tantingting/scmut/ref/bwa_ref/genome.fa
BAM_DIR=/mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut/bam/1_cSCC_scRNA
TUMOR_SPLIT_DIR=/mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut/vcf/1_cSCC_scRNA/hap_pool
OUT_DIR=/mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut/vcf/1_cSCC_scRNA/mutect2_pool
PON=/home/tantingting/scmut/ref/gatk_ref/gatk/1000g_pon.hg38.vcf.gz
GERMLINE=/home/tantingting/scmut/ref/gatk_ref/gatk/af-only-gnomad.hg38.vcf.gz
samples=(P4 P5 P6 P7 P9 P10)
mkdir -p "$OUT_DIR"

for s in "${samples[@]}"; do

    tumor="${s}_cSCC"
    normal="${s}_normal"
    tumor_bam="${TUMOR_SPLIT_DIR}/${tumor}/${tumor}.split.bam"
    normal_bam="${BAM_DIR}/${normal}/outs/possorted_genome_bam.bam"
    normal_split="${OUT_DIR}/${normal}.split.bam"
    raw_vcf="${OUT_DIR}/${tumor}_mutect2_raw.vcf.gz"
    filter_vcf="${OUT_DIR}/${tumor}_mutect2_PASS.vcf.gz"

    echo "========== ${tumor} =========="

    # normal RNA: SplitNCigarReads
    if [[ ! -f "$normal_split" ]]; then
        echo "[SplitNCigarReads] ${normal}"

        gatk SplitNCigarReads \
            -R "$REF_FA" \
            -I "$normal_bam" \
            -O "$normal_split" \
            --create-output-bam-index true
    fi

    # get SM from BAM header
    normal_sm=$(samtools view -H "$normal_split" |
        awk -F'\t' '$1=="@RG"{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i~/^SM:/){sub(/^SM:/,"",$i); print $i; exit}}')

    echo "Tumor : $tumor_bam"
    echo "Normal: $normal_split"
    echo "Normal SM: $normal_sm"

    # Mutect2
    memusg -t gatk Mutect2 \
        -R "$REF_FA" \
        -I "$tumor_bam" \
        -I "$normal_split" \
        -normal "$normal_sm" \
        --germline-resource "$GERMLINE" \
        --panel-of-normals "$PON" \
        --native-pair-hmm-threads 16 \
        -O "$raw_vcf"

    # Filter
	gatk FilterMutectCalls \
		-R "$REF_FA" \
		-V "$raw_vcf" \
		-O "$filter_vcf"

	FINAL="${OUT_DIR}/${tumor}_mutect2_PASS_norm.vcf.gz"

	bcftools view \
		-r chr1,chr2,chr3,chr4,chr5,chr6,chr7,chr8,chr9,chr10,chr11,chr12,chr13,chr14,chr15,chr16,chr17,chr18,chr19,chr20,chr21,chr22,chrX,chrY,chrM \
		-f PASS "$filter_vcf" -Ou |
	bcftools norm -f "$REF_FA" -m -both -Oz -o "$FINAL"

	bcftools index -f -t "$FINAL"

    echo "[DONE] ${tumor}"
done

## extract sample
WES_BASE=/mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut/vcf/1_cSCC_scRNA/mutect2_pool

for s in P4 P5 P6 P7 P9 P10; do
    VCF=$(find "$WES_BASE" -name "${s}_cSCC_mutect2_PASS_norm.vcf.gz" | head -1)
    TUMOR=$(bcftools query -l "$VCF" | head -1)
    OUT="${WES_BASE}/${s}_cSCC_mutect2_tumor_only.vcf.gz"

    echo "$s : $TUMOR"

    bcftools view -s "$TUMOR" "$VCF" -Oz -o "$OUT"
    bcftools index -f -t "$OUT"
done
```

<details>
<summary>Smart-seq2</summary>
```{bash,eval=FALSE}
export PATH=/home/tantingting/scmut/tools:$PATH

dataset="$1"
batch_file="$2"

ref_genome="/home/tantingting/scmut/ref/bwa_ref/genome.fa"
bam_dir="/mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut_smart/bam/${dataset}/md_bam"
out_base="/mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut_smart/vcf/${dataset}/hap"
filter_dir="${out_base}/filter"
chr_list="chr1,chr2,chr3,chr4,chr5,chr6,chr7,chr8,chr9,chr10,chr11,chr12,chr13,chr14,chr15,chr16,chr17,chr18,chr19,chr20,chr21,chr22,chrX,chrY,chrM"

mkdir -p "$out_base" "$filter_dir"

while read -r sample; do
    [[ -z "$sample" || "$sample" =~ ^# ]] && continue

    bam="${bam_dir}/${sample}_sortmd.bam"
    split_bam="${out_base}/${sample}.split.bam"
    raw_vcf="${out_base}/${sample}.hap.vcf.gz"
    pass_vcf="${filter_dir}/${sample}.hap_PASS.vcf.gz"
    tmp_dir="${filter_dir}/tmp_${sample}"
    mkdir -p "$tmp_dir"

    echo "========== ${dataset} | ${sample} =========="
    [[ ! -f "$bam" ]] && echo "[WARN] Missing $bam" && rm -rf "$tmp_dir" && continue

    if [[ ! -f "$raw_vcf" || ! -f "${raw_vcf}.tbi" ]]; then
        echo "[CALL] $sample"
        [[ ! -f "$split_bam" || ! -f "${split_bam}.bai" ]] && gatk SplitNCigarReads -R "$ref_genome" -I "$bam" -O "$split_bam" --create-output-bam-index true
        gatk HaplotypeCaller -R "$ref_genome" -I "$split_bam" -O "$raw_vcf" --native-pair-hmm-threads 16 --standard-min-confidence-threshold-for-calling 30.0
        tabix -f -p vcf "$raw_vcf"
    else
        echo "[SKIP CALL] $sample"
    fi

    if [[ ! -f "$pass_vcf" || ! -f "${pass_vcf}.tbi" ]]; then
        echo "[FILTER] $sample"

        norm_vcf="${tmp_dir}/${sample}.norm.vcf.gz"
        snp_vcf="${tmp_dir}/${sample}.snp.vcf.gz"
        indel_vcf="${tmp_dir}/${sample}.indel.vcf.gz"
        snp_filter="${tmp_dir}/${sample}.snp.filtered.vcf.gz"
        indel_filter="${tmp_dir}/${sample}.indel.filtered.vcf.gz"
        snp_pass="${tmp_dir}/${sample}.snp.pass.vcf.gz"
        indel_pass="${tmp_dir}/${sample}.indel.pass.vcf.gz"
        merge_vcf="${tmp_dir}/${sample}.merge.vcf.gz"

        bcftools norm -f "$ref_genome" -m -both "$raw_vcf" -Oz -o "$norm_vcf"
        tabix -f -p vcf "$norm_vcf"

        gatk SelectVariants -R "$ref_genome" -V "$norm_vcf" -select-type SNP -O "$snp_vcf"
        gatk SelectVariants -R "$ref_genome" -V "$norm_vcf" -select-type INDEL -O "$indel_vcf"

        gatk VariantFiltration -R "$ref_genome" -V "$snp_vcf" -filter "QD < 2.0" --filter-name "QD2" -filter "QUAL < 30.0" --filter-name "QUAL30" -filter "SOR > 3.0" --filter-name "SOR3" -filter "FS > 60.0" --filter-name "FS60" -filter "MQ < 40.0" --filter-name "MQ40" -filter "(vc.hasAttribute('MQRankSum') && MQRankSum < -12.5)" --filter-name "MQRS12.5" -filter "(vc.hasAttribute('ReadPosRankSum') && ReadPosRankSum < -8.0)" --filter-name "RPRS8" -O "$snp_filter"
        
		gatk VariantFiltration -R "$ref_genome" -V "$indel_vcf" -filter "QD < 2.0" --filter-name "QD2" -filter "QUAL < 30.0" --filter-name "QUAL30" -filter "FS > 200.0" --filter-name "FS200" -filter "(vc.hasAttribute('ReadPosRankSum') && ReadPosRankSum < -20.0)" --filter-name "RPRS20" -O "$indel_filter"


        bcftools view -f PASS -i 'FMT/DP[0]>10' "$snp_filter" -Oz -o "$snp_pass"
        tabix -f -p vcf "$snp_pass"

        bcftools view -f PASS -i 'FMT/DP[0]>15' "$indel_filter" -Oz -o "$indel_pass"
        tabix -f -p vcf "$indel_pass"

        bcftools concat -a "$snp_pass" "$indel_pass" -Oz -o "$merge_vcf"
        tabix -f -p vcf "$merge_vcf"

        bcftools view -r "$chr_list" "$merge_vcf" -Oz -o "$pass_vcf"
        tabix -f -p vcf "$pass_vcf"

        rm -rf "$tmp_dir"
        echo "[INFO] Final VCF: $pass_vcf"
        echo "[INFO] Kept sites: $(bcftools view -H "$pass_vcf" | wc -l)"
    else
        echo "[SKIP FILTER] $sample"
        echo "[INFO] Kept sites: $(bcftools view -H "$pass_vcf" | wc -l)"
    fi

    echo "[DONE] $sample"

done < "$batch_file"
```

## Monopogen

Monopogen detects germline and somatic variants from single-cell sequencing data using haplotype phasing and linkage disequilibrium information from reference panels.

The workflow included:
  
- Preprocessing: Prepare BAM files and genomic regions.
- Germline calling: Identify variants using population reference panels.
- Somatic calling: Detect cell-level somatic variants using the Monopogen workflow.

**Reference:** [Monopogen (Nature Biotechnology, 2024)](https://github.com/KChen-lab/Monopogen)


<details>
<summary>10x pooled level (germline)</summary>
  
**calling:**

```{python,eval=FALSE}
import pysam
import pandas as pd
from collections import defaultdict
import gzip

def count_barcode_reads_from_bam(bam_path, barcodes_path, output_path):
    """
    Count reads associated with filtered cell barcodes from a BAM file.

    Parameters:
        bam_path: Path to the Cell Ranger BAM file.
        barcodes_path: Path to filtered barcodes.tsv.gz.
        output_path: Path to the output CSV file.
    """

    # 1. Load filtered barcodes
    with gzip.open(barcodes_path, 'rt') as f:
        filtered_barcodes = {line.strip().split('-')[0] for line in f}

    # 2. Initialize counters
    barcode_counter = defaultdict(int)
    total_reads = 0
    processed_reads = 0

    # 3. Iterate over BAM reads
    with pysam.AlignmentFile(bam_path, "rb") as bam:
        print(f"Processing BAM file: {bam_path}")

        for read in bam:
            total_reads += 1

            # Display progress
            if total_reads % 10_000_000 == 0:
                print(f"Processed {total_reads/1_000_000:.1f}M reads...")

            # Extract cell barcode
            if read.has_tag('CB'):
                cb = read.get_tag('CB').split('-')[0]

                # Count reads matching filtered barcodes
                if cb in filtered_barcodes:
                    barcode_counter[cb] += 1
                    processed_reads += 1

    # 4. Save results
    results = [
        {'barcode': bc, 'reads': count}
        for bc, count in barcode_counter.items()
    ]
    pd.DataFrame(results).to_csv(output_path, index=False)

    print(f"Completed! Total reads: {total_reads}")
    print(f"Matched filtered barcodes: {len(results)}")
    print(f"Output saved to: {output_path}")

# Dataset 2: Melanoma scRNA-seq
count_barcode_reads_from_bam(
    bam_path='/mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut/bam/2_melanoma_scRNA/Acral1_SRR20791206/outs/possorted_genome_bam.bam',
    barcodes_path='/mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut/bam/2_melanoma_scRNA/Acral1_SRR20791206/outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix/barcodes.tsv.gz',
    output_path='/mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut/bam/2_melanoma_scRNA/Acral1_SRR20791206/outs/Acral1_SRR20791206_barcode_reads_orig.csv'
)


# Append "-1" to barcodes for downstream somatic variant calling

awk -F',' 'BEGIN{OFS=","} NR==1{print $1,$2; next} {print $1"-1",$2}' \
    /mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut/bam/2_melanoma_scRNA/Acral1_SRR20791206/outs/Acral1_SRR20791206_barcode_reads_orig.csv \
    > /mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut/bam/2_melanoma_scRNA/Acral1_SRR20791206/outs/Acral1_SRR20791206_barcode_reads_add1.csv
```

```{bash,eval=FALSE}
#!/bin/bash
path="/home/tantingting/scmut/tools/Monopogen"
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$LD_LIBRARY_PATH:${path}/apps

# Sample list (Dataset 2: melanoma scRNA-seq)

    "Acral2_SRR20791205"
    "Acral3post_SRR20791202"
    "Acral3pre_SRR20791203"

)
```

**filtering:**

```{python,eval=FALSE}
SC_BASE=$1

echo "======================================"
echo "Input directory: ${SC_BASE}"
echo "======================================"

mkdir -p "${SC_BASE}/pool_filter"

for SAMPLE_DIR in "${SC_BASE}"/*; do

    [ -d "$SAMPLE_DIR" ] || continue

    sample=$(basename "$SAMPLE_DIR")

    germline_dir="${SAMPLE_DIR}/germline"

    if [[ ! -d "$germline_dir" ]]; then
        echo "[WARN] Skip ${sample}: germline directory not found"
        continue
    fi

    echo
    echo "===== Processing ${sample} ====="

    GL_ALL="${SC_BASE}/pool_filter/${sample}.gl.all.vcf.gz"
    PHASED_ALL="${SC_BASE}/pool_filter/${sample}.phased.all.vcf.gz"
    GL_PASS="${SC_BASE}/pool_filter/${sample}.gl.depth_pass.vcf.gz"
    KEEP_KEYS="${SC_BASE}/pool_filter/${sample}.keep.keys.txt"
    FINAL="${SC_BASE}/pool_filter/${sample}_PASS.vcf.gz"

    ####################################
    # Step1: concat all chromosomes
    ####################################

    bcftools concat -a -Oz -o "$GL_ALL" \
        $(find "$germline_dir" -maxdepth 1 -name "chr*.gl.vcf.gz" | sort -V)

    bcftools index -t "$GL_ALL"

    bcftools concat -a -Oz -o "$PHASED_ALL" \
        $(find "$germline_dir" -maxdepth 1 -name "chr*.phased.vcf.gz" | sort -V)

    bcftools index -t "$PHASED_ALL"

    echo "[INFO] concat finished"

    ####################################
    # Step2: depth filter on GL
    ####################################

    bcftools view -i '
        (TYPE="snp"  && INFO/DP>10) ||
        (TYPE!="snp" && INFO/DP>15)
    ' "$GL_ALL" \
      -Oz -o "$GL_PASS"

    bcftools index -t "$GL_PASS"

    ####################################
    # Step3: extract passing sites
    ####################################

    bcftools query \
        -f '%CHROM:%POS:%REF:%ALT\n' \
        "$GL_PASS" | sort -u > "$KEEP_KEYS"

    echo "[INFO] GL depth-pass sites: $(wc -l < "$KEEP_KEYS")"

    ####################################
    # Step4: filter phased VCF
    ####################################

    bcftools view \
        -T <(
            awk -F: 'BEGIN{OFS="\t"}{
                print $1,$2,$2,$3,$4
            }' "$KEEP_KEYS"
        ) \
        "$PHASED_ALL" | \
    bcftools view -i '
        GT!="0/0" &&
        GT!="0|0" &&
        GT!="./." &&
        GT!=".|."
    ' \
        -Oz -o "$FINAL"

    bcftools index -t "$FINAL"

    ####################################
    # Cleanup
    ####################################

    rm -f "$GL_ALL" "$GL_ALL.tbi"
    rm -f "$PHASED_ALL" "$PHASED_ALL.tbi"
    rm -f "$GL_PASS" "$GL_PASS.tbi"

    echo "[INFO] Final VCF: $FINAL"
    echo "[INFO] Kept sites: $(bcftools view -H "$FINAL" | wc -l)"

done

echo
echo "======================================"
echo "ALL DONE"
echo "======================================"
```

**filtering:**

```{R,eval=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(data.table)
library(stringr)

MONO_BASE <- "/mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut/vcf/2_melanoma_scRNA/monopo"
samples <- c("Acral1_SRR20791206", "Acral2_SRR20791205", "Acral3pre_SRR20791203", "Acral3post_SRR20791202", "Acral4_SRR20791201", "Cutaneous1_SRR20791198", "Cutaneous1Lym_SRR20791196", "Cutaneous2_SRR20791197")
chroms <- paste0("chr", 1:22)

min_cells_with_any_reads <- 5
min_cells_with_alt_reads <- 2

parse_ref_alt_vec <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[is.na(x) | x == "" | x == "."] <- "0/0"
  ref <- as.numeric(sub("/.*", "", x))
  alt <- as.numeric(sub(".*/", "", x))
  data.frame(ref = ref, alt = alt)
}

process_one_chr <- function(sample, chr) {
  message("Processing ", sample, " ", chr, " ...")
  BASE_DIR <- file.path(MONO_BASE, sample, "somatic")
  OUT_DIR  <- file.path(MONO_BASE, sample, "somatic_combine")
  dir.create(OUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  meta_file <- file.path(BASE_DIR, paste0(chr, ".putativeSNVs.csv"))
  mat_file  <- file.path(BASE_DIR, paste0(chr, ".SNV_mat.RDS"))
  
  if (!file.exists(meta_file)) {
    warning("Missing meta file: ", meta_file)
    return(NULL)
  }
  if (!file.exists(mat_file)) {
    warning("Missing mat file: ", mat_file)
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  meta <- fread(meta_file, data.table = FALSE)
  meta_filter <- meta %>%
    filter(
      Depth_total > 10,
      BAF_alt > 0.05,
      SVM_pos_score > 0.1
    )
  
  message(chr, " meta total: ", nrow(meta),
          " | after meta filter: ", nrow(meta_filter))
          
  snv_pass <- paste0(
    meta_filter$chr, ":",
    meta_filter$pos, ":",
    meta_filter$Ref_allele, ":",
    meta_filter$Alt_allele
  )
  
  mat <- readRDS(mat_file)
  cell_cols <- colnames(mat)[19:ncol(mat)]
  common_snv <- intersect(snv_pass, rownames(mat))
  message(chr, " overlap SNVs: ", length(common_snv))
  mat_sub <- mat[common_snv, cell_cols, drop = FALSE]
  
  variant_stat <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(mat_sub)), function(i) {
    x <- unlist(mat_sub[i, ], use.names = FALSE)
    pa <- parse_ref_alt_vec(x)
    
    data.frame(
      sample = sample,
      chr = chr,
      snv = rownames(mat_sub)[i],
      n_cells_with_any_reads = sum((pa$ref + pa$alt) > 0),
      n_cells_with_alt_reads = sum(pa$alt > 0),
      total_ref_reads = sum(pa$ref),
      total_alt_reads = sum(pa$alt),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }) %>%
    bind_rows()
  
  variant_pass <- variant_stat %>%
    filter(
      n_cells_with_any_reads >= min_cells_with_any_reads,
      n_cells_with_alt_reads >= min_cells_with_alt_reads
    )
  
  message(chr, " after cell-level filter: ", nrow(variant_pass))
  message(chr, " cells: ", length(cell_cols))
  mat_pass <- mat_sub[variant_pass$snv, , drop = FALSE]
  
  cell_count <- sapply(cell_cols, function(cc) {
    x <- as.character(mat_pass[, cc])
    alt <- as.numeric(sub(".*/", "", x))
    alt[is.na(alt)] <- 0
    sum(alt > 0)
  })
  
  cell_count_df <- data.frame(
    sample = sample,
    chr = chr,
    cell = names(cell_count),
    n_variants = as.integer(cell_count),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  long_df <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(mat_pass)), function(i) {
    x <- as.character(mat_pass[i, ])
    pa <- parse_ref_alt_vec(x)
    
    data.frame(
      sample = sample,
      chr = chr,
      snv = rownames(mat_pass)[i],
      cell = colnames(mat_pass),
      ref_reads = pa$ref,
      alt_reads = pa$alt,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ) %>%
      filter(alt_reads > 0) %>%
      mutate(
        cell_id = paste0(sample, "_", cell),
        total_reads = ref_reads + alt_reads,
        baf_cell = alt_reads / total_reads
      )
  }) %>%
    bind_rows()
  
  rm(mat, mat_sub, mat_pass)
  gc()
  
  list(
    variant_stat = variant_stat,
    variant_pass = variant_pass,
    cell_count_df = cell_count_df,
    long_df = long_df
  )
}

process_one_sample <- function(sample) {  
  message("==============================")
  message("Start sample: ", sample)
  message("==============================")
  
  OUT_DIR <- file.path(MONO_BASE, sample, "somatic_combine")
  dir.create(OUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  res_list <- lapply(chroms, function(chr) {
    process_one_chr(sample, chr)
  })
  
  res_list <- res_list[!sapply(res_list, is.null)]
  
  if (length(res_list) == 0) {
    warning(sample, ": no valid chromosome results.")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  variant_stat_all <- bind_rows(lapply(res_list, `[[`, "variant_stat"))
  variant_pass_all <- bind_rows(lapply(res_list, `[[`, "variant_pass"))
  cell_count_by_chr <- bind_rows(lapply(res_list, `[[`, "cell_count_df"))
  cell_snv_long_all <- bind_rows(lapply(res_list, `[[`, "long_df"))
  
  cell_variant_count <- cell_count_by_chr %>%
    group_by(sample, cell) %>%
    summarise(
      n_variants = sum(n_variants),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      cell_id = paste0(sample, "_", cell)
    )
  
  list(
    variant_stat_all = variant_stat_all,
    variant_pass_all = variant_pass_all,
    cell_count_by_chr = cell_count_by_chr,
    cell_variant_count = cell_variant_count,
    cell_snv_long_all = cell_snv_long_all
  )
}

all_sample_results <- lapply(samples, process_one_sample)
names(all_sample_results) <- samples

all_sample_results <- all_sample_results[!sapply(all_sample_results, is.null)]


ALL_OUT_DIR <- file.path(MONO_BASE, "all_samples_somatic_combine")
dir.create(ALL_OUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

all_cell_variant_count <- bind_rows(lapply(all_sample_results, `[[`, "cell_variant_count"))
all_cell_snv_long <- bind_rows(lapply(all_sample_results, `[[`, "cell_snv_long_all"))
all_variant_pass <- bind_rows(lapply(all_sample_results, `[[`, "variant_pass_all"))

write.table(
  all_cell_variant_count,
  file = file.path(ALL_OUT_DIR, "All_samples_Monopogen_filtered_cell_variant_count.tsv"),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
)

write.table(
  all_cell_snv_long,
  file = file.path(ALL_OUT_DIR, "All_samples_Monopogen_filtered_cell_snv_long.tsv"),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
)

write.table(
  all_variant_pass,
  file = file.path(ALL_OUT_DIR, "All_samples_Monopogen_filtered_variant_pass.tsv"),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
)

```


**10x pooled level (somatic):**

```{bash,eval=FALSE}
###===== Linux command =====##
IN=/mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut/vcf/1_cSCC_scRNA/monopo/all_samples_somatic_combine/All_samples_Monopogen_filtered_cell_snv_long.tsv
OUT_BASE=/mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut/vcf/1_cSCC_scRNA/monopo/all_samples_somatic_combine

mkdir -p "$OUT_BASE"

for s in P4 P5 P6 P7 P9 P10; do
    sample="${s}_cSCC"
    OUT="${OUT_BASE}/${sample}_Monopogen_somatic_unique.vcf.gz"
    TMP="${OUT_BASE}/${sample}_Monopogen_somatic_unique.vcf"

    {
        echo '##fileformat=VCFv4.2'
        echo '##FORMAT=<ID=GT,Number=1,Type=String,Description="Genotype for RTG vcfeval compatibility">'
        echo -e "#CHROM\tPOS\tID\tREF\tALT\tQUAL\tFILTER\tINFO\tFORMAT\tTUMOR"

        awk -v s="$sample" '
        BEGIN{OFS="\t"}
        NR>1 && $1==s {
            split($3,a,":")
            key=a[1]":"a[2]":"a[3]":"a[4]
            if(!seen[key]++){
                print a[1],a[2],".",a[3],a[4],".","PASS",".","GT","0/1"
            }
        }' "$IN" | sort -k1,1V -k2,2n
    } > "$TMP"

    bgzip -f -c "$TMP" > "$OUT"
    tabix -f -p vcf "$OUT"
    rm "$TMP"

    echo "$sample : $(bcftools view -H "$OUT" | wc -l) unique SNVs"
done
```

## Freebayes

FreeBayes is a Bayesian haplotype-based variant caller for detecting SNVs and indels from aligned sequencing reads.

**Reference:** [FreeBayes (arXiv, 2012)](https://github.com/freebayes/freebayes)

</details>
  
<details>
<summary>10x pooled level</summary>
  
**calling:**
  
```{bash,eval=FALSE}
export PATH=/home/tantingting/scmut/tools:$PATH
ref_genome="/home/tantingting/scmut/ref/bwa_ref/genome.fa"
samples=("Acral1_SRR20791206" "Acral2_SRR20791205" "Acral3pre_SRR20791203" "Acral3post_SRR20791202" "Acral4_SRR20791201" "Cutaneous1_SRR20791198" "Cutaneous1Lym_SRR20791196" "Cutaneous2_SRR20791197" )

for sample in "${samples[@]}"
do
    BAM="/mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut/bam/2_melanoma_scRNA/${sample}/outs/possorted_genome_bam.bam"
    OUT_DIR="/mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut/vcf/2_melanoma_scRNA/freebayes_pool/${sample}"
    VCF_GZ="${OUT_DIR}/${sample}.vcf.gz"
    echo "Processing sample: ${sample}"
    mkdir -p "${OUT_DIR}"
    memusg -t freebayes-parallel /home/tantingting/scmut/ref/bwa_ref/10w_regions_1_xy.txt 16  -F 0.05 --min-coverage 10 -m 20 -q 20 -f "$ref_genome" "$BAM"  | bgzip -c > "$VCF_GZ"
done
```

  
**filtering:**

```{bash,eval=FALSE}
POOL_DIR=$1
REF="/home/tantingting/scmut/ref/bwa_ref/genome.fa"
OUT_DIR="${POOL_DIR}/filter"
mkdir -p "${OUT_DIR}"

echo "======================================"
echo "Input directory : ${POOL_DIR}"
echo "Output directory: ${OUT_DIR}"
echo "======================================"

for SAMPLE_DIR in "${POOL_DIR}"/*; do

    # Skip non-directory entries
    [ -d "${SAMPLE_DIR}" ] || continue

    sample=$(basename "${SAMPLE_DIR}")

    # Skip the filter directory itself
    if [ "${sample}" = "filter" ]; then
        continue
    fi

    INPUT_VCF="${SAMPLE_DIR}/${sample}.vcf"

    if [ ! -f "${INPUT_VCF}" ]; then
        echo "[WARN] Skip ${sample}: ${INPUT_VCF} not found"
        continue
    fi

    OUTPUT_VCF="${OUT_DIR}/${sample}_PASS.vcf.gz"

    echo
    echo "======================================"
    echo "Processing ${sample}"
    echo "======================================"

    bcftools norm -f "${REF}" \
        -m -both "${INPUT_VCF}" | \
    bcftools view \
        -i '
        FMT/GT!="0/0" &&
            QUAL>20 &&
            INFO/AF[0]>0.05 &&
            (
              (TYPE="snp"   && INFO/DP[0]>10) ||
              (TYPE!="snp"  && INFO/DP[0]>15)
            )
        ' \
        -Oz -o "${OUTPUT_VCF}"

    bcftools index -t "${OUTPUT_VCF}"
    NVAR=$(bcftools view -H "${OUTPUT_VCF}" | wc -l)
    echo "[INFO] ${sample}: ${NVAR} variants kept"

done

echo
echo "======================================"
echo "All samples finished"
echo "Results saved in:"
echo "${OUT_DIR}"
echo "======================================"
```

<details>
<summary>Smart-seq2</summary>
```{bash,eval=FALSE}
export PATH=/home/tantingting/scmut/tools:$PATH
dataset="$1"
batch_file="$2"

ref_genome="/home/tantingting/scmut/ref/bwa_ref/genome.fa"
region_file="/home/tantingting/scmut/ref/bwa_ref/10w_regions_1_xy.txt"

bam_dir="/mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut_smart/bam/${dataset}/md_bam"
out_base="/mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut_smart/vcf/${dataset}/freebayes"
filter_dir="${out_base}/filter"

mkdir -p "$out_base" "$filter_dir"

while read -r sample; do
    [[ -z "$sample" || "$sample" =~ ^# ]] && continue

    bam="${bam_dir}/${sample}_sortmd.bam"
    raw_vcf="${out_base}/${sample}.freebayes.vcf.gz"
    pass_vcf="${filter_dir}/${sample}.freebayes_PASS.vcf.gz"

    echo "========== ${dataset} | ${sample} =========="
    [[ ! -f "$bam" ]] && echo "[WARN] Missing $bam" && continue

    if [[ ! -f "$raw_vcf" || ! -f "${raw_vcf}.tbi" ]]; then
        echo "[CALL] $sample"

        memusg -t bash -c '
          freebayes-parallel "'"$region_file"'" 16 -F 0.05 --min-coverage 10 -m 20 -q 20 -f "'"$ref_genome"'" "'"$bam"'" | bgzip -c > "'"$raw_vcf"'"
        '

        [[ ! -f "$raw_vcf" ]] && echo "[ERROR] CALL failed: $sample" && continue
        tabix -p vcf "$raw_vcf"
    else
        echo "[SKIP CALL] $sample"
    fi

    if [[ ! -f "$pass_vcf" || ! -f "${pass_vcf}.tbi" ]]; then
        echo "[FILTER] $sample"

        bcftools norm -f "$ref_genome" -m -both "$raw_vcf" | \
        bcftools view -i '
            FMT/GT!="0/0" &&
            QUAL>20 &&
            INFO/AF[0]>0.05 &&
            (
                (TYPE="snp"  && INFO/DP[0]>10) ||
                (TYPE!="snp" && INFO/DP[0]>15)
            )
        ' -Oz -o "$pass_vcf"

        [[ ! -f "$pass_vcf" ]] && echo "[ERROR] FILTER failed: $sample" && continue
        tabix -p vcf "$pass_vcf"

        echo "[INFO] Filtered VCF: $pass_vcf"
        echo "[INFO] Kept sites: $(bcftools view -H "$pass_vcf" | wc -l)"
    else
        echo "[SKIP FILTER] $sample"
        echo "[INFO] Kept sites: $(bcftools view -H "$pass_vcf" | wc -l)"
    fi

    echo "[DONE] $sample"

done < "$batch_file"
```


## Strelka2

Strelka2 is a haplotype-based variant caller designed to detect germline and somatic SNVs and indels. Although primarily developed for DNA sequencing, it can also be applied to RNA-seq data using RNA-specific settings.

The workflow included:

- Variant calling: Detect SNVs and indels using the Strelka2 workflow, with the `--rna` option enabled for RNA-seq analysis.

**Reference:** [Strelka2 (Nature Methods, 2018)](https://github.com/Illumina/strelka)

</details>
  
<details>
<summary>10x pooled level</summary>

```{bash,eval=FALSE}
export PATH=/home/tantingting/scmut/tools:$PATH
sample="$1"
REF_GENOME="/home/tantingting/scmut/ref/bwa_ref/genome.fa"
BASE_BAM_DIR="/mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut/bam/2_melanoma_scRNA"
OUT_BASE="/mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut/vcf/2_melanoma_scRNA/strelka2_pool"
STRELKA_BIN="/home/tantingting/scmut/tools/strelka-2.9.10.centos6_x86_64/bin/configureStrelkaGermlineWorkflow.py"
PASS_DIR="${OUT_BASE}/filter"

mkdir -p "${OUT_BASE}"
mkdir -p "${PASS_DIR}"

bam="${BASE_BAM_DIR}/${sample}/outs/possorted_genome_bam.bam"

echo "========== ${sample} =========="

if [[ ! -f "$bam" ]]; then
    echo "[ERROR] BAM not found:"
    echo "$bam"
    exit 1
fi

run_dir="${OUT_BASE}/${sample}"
log_file="${run_dir}/${sample}.log"

RAW="${run_dir}/results/variants/variants.vcf.gz"
FINAL="${PASS_DIR}/${sample}.pass.vcf.gz"

echo "[CONFIG] ${sample}"

"${STRELKA_BIN}" \
    --bam "${bam}" \
    --rna \
    --referenceFasta "${REF_GENOME}" \
    --runDir "${run_dir}"

echo "[RUN] ${sample}"

memusg -t \
    "${run_dir}/runWorkflow.py" \
    -m local \
    -j 16 \
    > "${log_file}" 2>&1

echo "[FILTER] ${sample}"

bcftools view \
    -r chr1,chr2,chr3,chr4,chr5,chr6,chr7,chr8,chr9,chr10,chr11,chr12,chr13,chr14,chr15,chr16,chr17,chr18,chr19,chr20,chr21,chr22,chrX,chrY,chrM \
    -i 'ALT!="." && FILTER="PASS"' \
    "$RAW" | \
bcftools norm \
    -f "${REF_GENOME}" \
    -m -both | \
bcftools view \
    -i '
        ALT!="." &&
        FMT/GT!="0/0" &&
        FMT/GT!="0|0" &&
        QUAL>20 &&
        (FMT/AD[0:0] + FMT/AD[0:1]) > 0 &&
        (FMT/AD[0:1] / (FMT/AD[0:0] + FMT/AD[0:1])) > 0.05 &&
        (
            (TYPE="snp" && FMT/DP > 10) ||
            (TYPE!="snp" && FMT/DPI > 15)
        )
    ' \
    -Oz \
    -o "${FINAL}"

bcftools index -t "${FINAL}"
nvar=$(bcftools view -H "${FINAL}" | wc -l)
```

```{bash,eval=FALSE}
        FMT/GT!="0|0" &&
        QUAL>20 &&
        (FMT/AD[0:0] + FMT/AD[0:1]) > 0 &&
        (FMT/AD[0:1] / (FMT/AD[0:0] + FMT/AD[0:1])) > 0.05 &&
        (
            (TYPE="snp" && FMT/DP > 10) ||
            (TYPE!="snp" && FMT/DPI > 15)
        )
    ' \
    -Oz \
    -o "${FINAL}"

bcftools index -t "${FINAL}"

nvar=$(bcftools view -H "${FINAL}" | wc -l)

echo
echo "[DONE] ${sample}"
echo "[VCF] ${FINAL}"
echo "[Variants] ${nvar}"
echo
```

```{bash,eval=FALSE}
# Reference genome and output directories
REF=/home/tantingting/scmut/ref/bwa_ref/genome.fa
OUT_BASE=/mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut/vcf/1_cSCC_scRNA/strelka2_somatic_pool
PASS_DIR="${OUT_BASE}/filter"

# Sample list and target chromosomes
samples=(P4_cSCC P5_cSCC P6_cSCC P7_cSCC P9_cSCC P10_cSCC)
CHR="chr1,chr2,chr3,chr4,chr5,chr6,chr7,chr8,chr9,chr10,chr11,chr12,chr13,chr14,chr15,chr16,chr17,chr18,chr19,chr20,chr21,chr22,chrX,chrY,chrM"

mkdir -p "$PASS_DIR"

for sample in "${samples[@]}"; do

    # Define input SNV/indel VCFs and final output
    run_dir="${OUT_BASE}/${sample}"
    SNV="${run_dir}/results/variants/somatic.snvs.vcf.gz"
    INDEL="${run_dir}/results/variants/somatic.indels.vcf.gz"
    FINAL="${PASS_DIR}/${sample}_somatic_PASS_norm.vcf.gz"

    echo "========== ${sample} =========="

    # Check input VCF files
    [[ -f "$SNV" ]] || { echo "[ERROR] Missing $SNV"; continue; }
    [[ -f "$INDEL" ]] || { echo "[ERROR] Missing $INDEL"; continue; }

    # Count PASS variants before merging
    echo "SNV PASS:   $(bcftools view -f PASS -H "$SNV" | wc -l)"
    echo "INDEL PASS: $(bcftools view -f PASS -H "$INDEL" | wc -l)"

    # Merge SNVs and indels, sort, retain PASS variants,
    # and normalize against the reference genome
    bcftools concat -a "$SNV" "$INDEL" -Ou |
        bcftools sort -Ou |
        bcftools view -t "$CHR" -f PASS -Ou |
        bcftools norm -f "$REF" -m -both -Oz -o "$FINAL"

    # Index the normalized VCF
    bcftools index -f -t "$FINAL"

    echo "[DONE] $sample"
    echo "[Variants] $(bcftools view -H "$FINAL" | wc -l)"
    echo "[VCF] $FINAL"
    echo
done

# Extract the tumor sample from each somatic VCF
STRELKA_BASE=/mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut/vcf/1_cSCC_scRNA/strelka2_somatic_pool/filter

for s in P4 P5 P6 P7 P9 P10; do

    VCF="${STRELKA_BASE}/${s}_cSCC_somatic_PASS_norm.vcf.gz"
    TUMOR=$(bcftools query -l "$VCF" | tail -1)

    OUT="${STRELKA_BASE}/${s}_cSCC_somatic_PASS_norm_tumor_only.vcf.gz"

    echo "$s : $TUMOR"

    # Retain only the tumor sample and index the output VCF
    bcftools view -s "$TUMOR" "$VCF" -Oz -o "$OUT"
    bcftools index -f -t "$OUT"

done

# Add GT information for compatibility with RTG vcfeval
BASE=/mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut/vcf/1_cSCC_scRNA/strelka2_somatic_pool/filter

for s in P4 P5 P6 P7 P9 P10; do

    IN="${BASE}/${s}_cSCC_somatic_PASS_norm_tumor_only.vcf.gz"
    OUT="${BASE}/${s}_cSCC_somatic_PASS_norm_rtg.vcf.gz"
    TMP="${BASE}/${s}_cSCC_somatic_PASS_norm_rtg.vcf"

    {
        # Preserve VCF header metadata while removing the existing GT definition
        bcftools view -h "$IN" |
        grep -v '^#CHROM' |
        grep -v '##FORMAT=<ID=GT'

        # Add a GT field definition for RTG vcfeval
        echo '##FORMAT=<ID=GT,Number=1,Type=String,Description="Genotype added for RTG vcfeval compatibility">'

        # Write the tumor-only VCF column header
        echo -e "#CHROM\tPOS\tID\tREF\tALT\tQUAL\tFILTER\tINFO\tFORMAT\tTUMOR"

        # Assign a heterozygous genotype (0/1) to each retained variant
        bcftools view -H "$IN" |
        awk 'BEGIN{OFS="\t"} {print $1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8,"GT","0/1"}'

    } > "$TMP"

    # Compress, index, and remove the temporary VCF
    bgzip -f -c "$TMP" > "$OUT"
    tabix -f -p vcf "$OUT"
    rm "$TMP"

    echo "[DONE] $s"
done
```

```{bash,eval=FALSE}
export PATH=/home/tantingting/scmut/tools:$PATH
dataset="$1"
batch_file="$2"
REF_GENOME="/home/tantingting/scmut/ref/bwa_ref/genome.fa"
BAM_DIR="/mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut_smart/bam/${dataset}/md_bam"
OUT_BASE="/mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut_smart/vcf/${dataset}/strelka2"

STRELKA_BIN="/home/tantingting/scmut/tools/strelka-2.9.10.centos6_x86_64/bin/configureStrelkaGermlineWorkflow.py"

PASS_DIR="${OUT_BASE}/filter"

mkdir -p "${OUT_BASE}"
mkdir -p "${PASS_DIR}"

while read -r sample; do

    [[ -z "$sample" || "$sample" =~ ^# ]] && continue

    bam="${BAM_DIR}/${sample}_sortmd.bam"

    echo "========== ${dataset} | ${sample} =========="

    if [[ ! -f "$bam" ]]; then
        echo "[ERROR] BAM not found: $bam"
        continue
    fi

    run_dir="${OUT_BASE}/${sample}"
    log_file="${OUT_BASE}/${sample}/${sample}.log"

    RAW="${run_dir}/results/variants/variants.vcf.gz"
    FINAL="${PASS_DIR}/${sample}.pass.vcf.gz"

    if [[ -f "$FINAL" ]]; then
        echo "[SKIP] ${sample}"
        continue
    fi
    echo "[CONFIG] ${sample}"

    "${STRELKA_BIN}" \
        --bam "${bam}" \
        --rna \
        --referenceFasta "${REF_GENOME}" \
        --runDir "${run_dir}"

    if [[ $? -ne 0 ]]; then
        echo "[FAILED CONFIG] ${sample}"
        continue
    fi

    echo "[RUN] ${sample}"

    memusg -t \
        "${run_dir}/runWorkflow.py" \
        -m local \
        -j 16 \
        > "${log_file}" 2>&1

    if [[ $? -ne 0 ]]; then
        echo "[FAILED] ${sample}"
        continue
    fi

    echo "[FILTER] ${sample}"

    bcftools view \
      -r chr1,chr2,chr3,chr4,chr5,chr6,chr7,chr8,chr9,chr10,chr11,chr12,chr13,chr14,chr15,chr16,chr17,chr18,chr19,chr20,chr21,chr22,chrX,chrY,chrM \
      -i 'ALT!="." && FILTER="PASS"' \
      "$RAW" | \
    bcftools norm -f "${REF_GENOME}" -m -both | \
    bcftools view -i '
      ALT!="." &&
      FMT/GT!="0/0" &&
      FMT/GT!="0|0" &&
      QUAL>20 &&
      (FMT/AD[0:1] / (FMT/AD[0:0] + FMT/AD[0:1])) > 0.05 &&
      (
        (TYPE="snp"   && FMT/DP  > 10) ||
        (TYPE!="snp" && FMT/DPI > 15)
      )
    ' -Oz -o "$FINAL"

    bcftools index -t "${FINAL}"
    nvar=$(bcftools view -H "${FINAL}" | wc -l)

    echo "[DONE] ${sample}  Variants=${nvar}"
    echo

done < "${batch_file}"
```

## scSNV

scSNV detects single-nucleotide variants from droplet-based scRNA-seq data using UMI consensus collapsing to reduce sequencing errors.

The workflow included:

- Barcode counting: Identify cell barcodes from FASTQ files using a chemistry-specific barcode whitelist.
- Read mapping: Align reads to the reference genome using `scsnv map`.
- UMI collapsing: Collapse reads sharing the same UMI to reduce sequencing errors.
- Cell identification: Identify valid cell barcodes using `scsnvmisc cells`.
- Variant detection: Generate allele-specific pileups from collapsed reads.
- Annotation: Annotate variants using population and RNA-editing reference databases.
- Post-processing: Convert annotated results into sparse matrices using `scsnv2mtx` for downstream analysis.

**10x chemistry settings:**

- 10x 3' v2: `-l V2`, whitelist: `737K-august-2016.txt`
- 10x 3' v3: `-l V3`, whitelist: `3M-february-2018.txt`
- 10x 5' v2: `-l V2_5P`
- 10x 5' v3: `-l V3_5P`

**Reference:** [scSNV (Genome Biology, 2021)](https://github.com/GWW/scsnv)

<details>
<summary>10x pooled level</summary>

**calling:**

```{bash,eval=FALSE}
#!/bin/bash
export PATH=/home/tantingting/scmut/tools:$PATH

samples=("Acral1_SRR20791206" "Acral2_SRR20791205" "Cutaneous1_SRR20791198")

ref_dir="/home/tantingting/scmut/ref"
bwa_ref="${ref_dir}/bwa_ref"
anno_dir="${ref_dir}/scsnv_anno"

scsnv_bin="/home/tantingting/scmut/tools/scsnv/build/src/scsnv"
fastq_root="/mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut/fastp/2_melanoma_scRNA"
out_root="/mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut/vcf/2_melanoma_scRNA/scsnv"

barcode_file="/home/tantingting/scmut/tools/scsnv/data/737K-august-2016.txt"

for sample in "${samples[@]}"; do
    echo ">>> Processing $sample"

    fastq_dir="${fastq_root}/${sample}"
    out_dir="${out_root}/${sample}"
    mkdir -p "$out_dir"

    ## 1. count
    memusg -t "$scsnv_bin" count -l V2 \
        -o "$out_dir/barcode" \
        -k "$barcode_file" "$fastq_dir"
    echo "$sample: 1.count done"
    
    ## 2. map
    memusg -t "$scsnv_bin" map -l V2 \
        -i "$bwa_ref/scsnv_ref" \
        -g "$bwa_ref/genome.fa" \
        -b "$out_dir/barcode" \
        -t 16 --bam-write 4 -q 4 \
        -o "$out_dir/" "$fastq_dir"
    echo "$sample: 2.map done"
    
    ## 3. collapse
    memusg -t "$scsnv_bin" collapse -l V2 \
        -r "$bwa_ref/genome.fa" \
        -i "$bwa_ref/scsnv_ref" \
        -b "$out_dir/barcode_counts.txt.gz" \
        --threads 16 --bam-write 8 \
        -o "$out_dir/" "$out_dir/merged.bam"
    echo "$sample: 3.collapse done"

    ## 4. cells
    memusg -t scsnvmisc cells --skip-mt -o "$out_dir" "$out_dir/summary.h5"
    echo "$sample: 4.cells done"
    
    ## 5. pileup
    memusg -t "$scsnv_bin" pileup -l V2 -t 8 -x 8 \
         -i "$bwa_ref/scsnv_ref" \
         -r "$bwa_ref/genome.fa" \
         -p "$out_dir/passed_barcodes.txt.gz" \
         -o "$out_dir/pileup" "$out_dir/collapsed.bam"
    echo "$sample: 5.pileup done"
    
    ## 6. annotate
    memusg -t scsnvmisc annotate \
        -d "$anno_dir/1000Genome_change.txt" \
        -e "$anno_dir/TABLE1_hg38_v2.txt" \
        "$out_dir/pileup"
    echo "$sample: 6.annotate done"

    memusg -t scsnv2mtx "$out_dir/pileup_annotated.h5" "$out_dir"
    echo "$sample: 7.scsnv2mtx done"
    
    echo ">>> $sample finished."
    echo "----------------------------------"
done

echo "All samples done."
```

**filering (pooled level):**

```{bash,eval=FALSE}
SC_BASE=$1

echo "======================================"
echo "Input directory: ${SC_BASE}"
echo "======================================"

mkdir -p "${SC_BASE}/filter"

for SAMPLE_DIR in "${SC_BASE}"/*; do

    [ -d "$SAMPLE_DIR" ] || continue

    sample=$(basename "$SAMPLE_DIR")

    in_csv="${SAMPLE_DIR}/snvs.csv"

    if [[ ! -f "$in_csv" ]]; then
        echo "[WARN] Skip ${sample}: snvs.csv not found"
        continue
    fi

    echo ">>> Processing ${sample}"

    out_prefix="${SC_BASE}/filter/${sample}"

    ####################################
    # Step1: CSV filter
    ####################################
    awk -F',' '
    BEGIN{OFS=","}
    NR==1{
        print "chrom","pos","ref","alt","ref_count","alt_count","strand","strand_AF","total_barcodes"
        next
    }
    {
        chrom=$1
        pos=$2
        ref=$3
        alt=$4

        refc=$5+0
        altc=$8+0

        strand=$15
        af=$20+0
        barcodes=$22+0

        dp=refc+altc

        if (chrom !~ /^chr([1-9]|1[0-9]|2[0-2]|X|Y|M)$/) next
        if (dp <= 10) next
        if (af <= 0.05) next

        print chrom,pos,ref,alt,refc,altc,strand,af,barcodes
    }' "$in_csv" > "${out_prefix}.filtered.csv"

    ####################################
    # Step2: CSV -> VCF
    ####################################
    awk -F',' '
    BEGIN{
        OFS="\t"

        print "##fileformat=VCFv4.2"
        print "##source=scSNV"

        for(i=1;i<=22;i++)
            print "##contig=<ID=chr"i">"

        print "##contig=<ID=chrX>"
        print "##contig=<ID=chrY>"
        print "##contig=<ID=chrM>"

        print "##INFO=<ID=REF_COUNT,Number=1,Type=Integer,Description=\"Reference allele count\">"
        print "##INFO=<ID=ALT_COUNT,Number=1,Type=Integer,Description=\"Alternative allele count\">"
        print "##INFO=<ID=DP,Number=1,Type=Integer,Description=\"Depth\">"
        print "##INFO=<ID=STRAND,Number=1,Type=String,Description=\"Strand\">"
        print "##INFO=<ID=STRAND_AF,Number=1,Type=Float,Description=\"Strand AF\">"
        print "##INFO=<ID=TOTAL_BARCODES,Number=1,Type=Integer,Description=\"Total barcodes\">"

        print "##FORMAT=<ID=GT,Number=1,Type=String,Description=\"Genotype\">"

        print "#CHROM","POS","ID","REF","ALT","QUAL","FILTER","INFO","FORMAT","SAMPLE"
    }
    NR==1{next}
    {
        refc=$5+0
        altc=$6+0
        dp=refc+altc

        info="REF_COUNT="refc";ALT_COUNT="altc";DP="dp";STRAND="$7";STRAND_AF="$8";TOTAL_BARCODES="$9

        print $1,$2+1,".",$3,$4,".","PASS",info,"GT","0/1"
    }' "${out_prefix}.filtered.csv" > "${out_prefix}.pos1.vcf"

    ####################################
    # Step3: sort + compress + index
    ####################################
    bcftools sort \
        "${out_prefix}.pos1.vcf" \
        -o "${out_prefix}_PASS.vcf"

    bgzip -f "${out_prefix}_PASS.vcf"

    tabix -f -p vcf \
        "${out_prefix}_PASS.vcf.gz"

    echo "[OK] ${sample}"

done

echo "======================================"
echo "ALL DONE"
echo "======================================"
```

<details>
<summary>10x single-cell level</summary>

```{bash,eval=FALSE}
import os
import argparse
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.io import mmread

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Extract filtered scSNV cell-mutation pairs and per-cell mutation counts.")
    parser.add_argument("--sample", required=True, help="Sample name, e.g. P5_cSCC")
    parser.add_argument("--indir", required=True, help="scSNV output directory")
    parser.add_argument("--outdir", required=True, help="Output directory")

    args = parser.parse_args()

    sample = args.sample
    indir = args.indir
    outdir = args.outdir
    os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)

    barcode_file = os.path.join(indir, "barcodes.txt")
    snv_file = os.path.join(indir, "snvs.csv")
    alt_file = os.path.join(indir, "alts.mtx")
    filtered_file = os.path.join(indir, args.filtered_csv)

    print(f"[INFO] sample: {sample}")
    print(f"[INFO] input dir: {indir}")

    # 1. Read cell barcodes and remove any trailing "-1" suffix
    barcodes = pd.read_csv(barcode_file, header=None, names=["cell"])
    barcodes["cell"] = barcodes["cell"].astype(str).str.replace("-1$", "", regex=True)
    barcodes["cell_index0"] = np.arange(barcodes.shape[0])
    print(f"[INFO] n_cells: {barcodes.shape[0]}")

    # 2. Read all SNV information; row indices in alts.mtx correspond to SNV row indices
    snvs = pd.read_csv(snv_file)
    snvs["snv_index0"] = np.arange(snvs.shape[0])
    snvs["mut"] = snvs["chrom"].astype(str) + ":" + snvs["pos"].astype(str) + ":" + snvs["ref"].astype(str) + ":" + snvs["alt"].astype(str)
    print(f"[INFO] n_all_snvs: {snvs.shape[0]}")

    # 3. Read the filtered SNV list for subsequent filtering by mutation ID
    filtered = pd.read_csv(filtered_file)
    filtered["mut"] = filtered["chrom"].astype(str) + ":" + filtered["pos"].astype(str) + ":" + filtered["ref"].astype(str) + ":" + filtered["alt"].astype(str)
    keep_mut = set(filtered["mut"])  # Convert mutation IDs to a set
    print(f"[INFO] n_filtered_snvs: {len(keep_mut)}")

    # 4. Read alts.mtx and retain cell-SNV records with alt_count > 0
    print("[INFO] reading alts.mtx ...")
    alt_mtx = mmread(alt_file).tocoo()
    print(f"[INFO] alt matrix shape: {alt_mtx.shape}")  # Verify matrix dimensions

    if alt_mtx.shape[0] != snvs.shape[0]:
        raise ValueError("Number of SNVs in alts.mtx does not match snvs.csv.")
    if alt_mtx.shape[1] != barcodes.shape[0]:
        raise ValueError("Number of cells in alts.mtx does not match barcodes.txt.")

    # Row index (SNV) | Column index (cell) | Value (alternative allele read count)
    df = pd.DataFrame({"snv_index0": alt_mtx.row.astype(np.int64), "cell_index0": alt_mtx.col.astype(np.int64), "alt_count": alt_mtx.data.astype(np.int32)})
    df = df[df["alt_count"] > 0].copy()
    print(f"[INFO] cell-SNV records with alt_count > 0 before filtering: {df.shape[0]}")

    # 5. Map matrix indices back to mutation IDs and cell barcodes
    df = df.merge(barcodes[["cell_index0", "cell"]], on="cell_index0", how="left")
    df = df.merge(snvs[["snv_index0", "mut"]], on="snv_index0", how="left")

    # 6. Retain mutations present in the filtered SNV list
    df = df[df["mut"].isin(keep_mut)].copy()
    print(f"[INFO] cell-SNV records after filtered SNV list: {df.shape[0]}")

    # 7. Export unique cell-mutation pairs
    cell_mut = df[["cell", "mut"]].drop_duplicates()
    out_cell_mut = os.path.join(outdir, f"{sample}_scSNV_filtered_cell_mut.tsv.gz")
    cell_mut.to_csv(out_cell_mut, sep="\t", index=False, compression="gzip")
    print(f"[INFO] saved cell-mut table: {out_cell_mut}")

    # 8. Count filtered mutations per cell, retaining cells with zero mutations
    cell_count = cell_mut.groupby("cell", as_index=False).agg(n_variants=("mut", "nunique"))
    all_cells = barcodes[["cell"]].copy()
    cell_count = all_cells.merge(cell_count, on="cell", how="left")
    cell_count["n_variants"] = cell_count["n_variants"].fillna(0).astype(int)
    cell_count.insert(0, "sample", sample)
    cell_count.insert(1, "tool", "scSNV")

    out_count = os.path.join(outdir, f"{sample}_scSNV_filtered_cell_variant_count.tsv")
    cell_count.to_csv(out_count, sep="\t", index=False)
    print(f"[INFO] saved cell count table: {out_count}")
    print("[DONE]")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```{python,eval=FALSE}
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import glob

BASE_DIR = "/mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut/vcf/2_melanoma_scRNA/scsnv"
BAM_DIR = "/mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut/bam/2_melanoma_scRNA"

samples = ["Acral1_SRR20791206", "Acral2_SRR20791205", "Acral3pre_SRR20791203", "Acral3post_SRR20791202", "Acral4_SRR20791201", "Cutaneous1_SRR20791198", "Cutaneous1Lym_SRR20791196", "Cutaneous2_SRR20791197"]

all_df = []

for sample in samples:
    count_file = f"{BASE_DIR}/{sample}/cell_snv/{sample}_scSNV_filtered_cell_variant_count.tsv"
    reads_file = f"{BAM_DIR}/{sample}/outs/{sample}_barcode_reads_map.csv"

    count_df = pd.read_csv(count_file, sep="\t")
    reads_df = pd.read_csv(reads_file)
    reads_df = reads_df.rename(columns={"id": "reads"})

    # Use the cells reported by scSNV as the reference cell set
    df = count_df.merge(reads_df[["cell", "reads"]], on="cell", how="left")
    df["sample"] = sample
    df["cell_id"] = df["sample"] + "_" + df["cell"].astype(str)
    all_df.append(df)

df_all = pd.concat(all_df, ignore_index=True)

# Remove cells with missing read counts
df_all = df_all.dropna(subset=["reads"]).copy()
df_all["reads"] = df_all["reads"].astype(int)
df_all["n_variants"] = df_all["n_variants"].astype(int)

OUT_FILE = "/mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut/vcf/2_melanoma_scRNA/scsnv/scSNV_variant_count_vs_reads_input.tsv"
df_all.to_csv(OUT_FILE, sep="\t", index=False)
```

```{python,eval=FALSE}
import os
import pandas as pd

BASE_DIR = "/mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut/vcf/2_melanoma_scRNA/scsnv"
BAM_DIR = "/mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut/bam/2_melanoma_scRNA"

samples = [
    "Acral1_SRR20791206",
    "Acral2_SRR20791205",
    "Acral3pre_SRR20791203",
    "Acral3post_SRR20791202",
    "Acral4_SRR20791201",
    "Cutaneous1_SRR20791198",
    "Cutaneous1Lym_SRR20791196",
    "Cutaneous2_SRR20791197"
]

all_count = []
for sample in samples:
    print(f"\n===== {sample} =====")

    # Extract the short sample name used in the original scSNV output
    sample_short = sample.split("_SRR")[0]

    # Input files
    cell_mut_file = (
        f"{BASE_DIR}/{sample}/cell_snv/"
        f"{sample_short}_scSNV_filtered_cell_mut.tsv.gz"
    )

    reads_file = (
        f"{BAM_DIR}/{sample}/outs/"
        f"{sample}_barcode_reads_map.csv"
    )

    # Read cell-mutation pairs and Cell Ranger read counts
    cell_mut = pd.read_csv(cell_mut_file, sep="\t")
    reads_df = pd.read_csv(reads_file).rename(columns={"id": "reads"})

    # Standardize barcode formats by removing the trailing "-1"
    cell_mut["cell"] = (
        cell_mut["cell"]
        .astype(str)
        .str.replace("-1$", "", regex=True)
    )

    reads_df["cell"] = (
        reads_df["cell"]
        .astype(str)
        .str.replace("-1$", "", regex=True)
    )

    # Cells in the reads table are considered valid Cell Ranger cells
    all_cells = reads_df[["cell", "reads"]].drop_duplicates()
    valid_cells = set(all_cells["cell"])

    print(f"[1] scSNV raw cell-mut pairs: {len(cell_mut)}")
    print(f"[1] scSNV raw SNVs: {cell_mut['mut'].nunique()}")
    print(f"[1] scSNV raw cells: {cell_mut['cell'].nunique()}")
    print(f"[2] CellRanger valid cells: {len(valid_cells)}")

    # Remove scSNV-specific cells absent from the Cell Ranger reads table
    cell_mut_valid = (
        cell_mut[cell_mut["cell"].isin(valid_cells)]
        .drop_duplicates()
    )

    removed_cells = set(cell_mut["cell"]) - valid_cells

    print(f"[3] removed scSNV-only cells: {len(removed_cells)}")
    print(f"[3] after valid-cell filter pairs: {len(cell_mut_valid)}")
    print(f"[3] after valid-cell filter SNVs: {cell_mut_valid['mut'].nunique()}")
    print(f"[3] after valid-cell filter cells: {cell_mut_valid['cell'].nunique()}")

    # Recalculate the number of supporting cells per SNV
    # Retain SNVs detected in at least two valid cells
    snv_ncells = (
        cell_mut_valid
        .groupby("mut")["cell"]
        .nunique()
        .reset_index(name="n_cells")
    )

    keep = set(
        snv_ncells.loc[snv_ncells["n_cells"] >= 2, "mut"]
    )

    cell_mut_min2 = (
        cell_mut_valid[cell_mut_valid["mut"].isin(keep)]
        .drop_duplicates()
    )

    print(f"[4] SNVs before min2cells: {cell_mut_valid['mut'].nunique()}")
    print(f"[4] SNVs after min2cells: {cell_mut_min2['mut'].nunique()}")
    print(f"[4] cell-mut pairs after min2cells: {len(cell_mut_min2)}")
    print(f"[4] cells with >=1 retained SNV: {cell_mut_min2['cell'].nunique()}")

    # Export filtered cell-mutation pairs
    out_long = (
        f"{BASE_DIR}/{sample}/cell_snv/"
        f"{sample}_scSNV_cell_mut_validcell_min2c.tsv.gz"
    )

    cell_mut_min2.to_csv(
        out_long,
        sep="\t",
        index=False,
        compression="gzip"
    )

    # Recalculate the number of retained variants per cell
    cell_count = (
        cell_mut_min2
        .groupby("cell", as_index=False)
        .agg(n_variants=("mut", "nunique"))
    )

    # Retain cells shared by scSNV and Cell Ranger
    # Only cells with at least one retained SNV are included
    count_df = cell_count.merge(
        all_cells,
        on="cell",
        how="inner"
    )

    count_df["n_variants"] = count_df["n_variants"].astype(int)
    count_df.insert(0, "sample", sample)
    count_df.insert(1, "tool", "scSNV")

    count_df["cell_id"] = (
        count_df["sample"] + "_" + count_df["cell"].astype(str)
    )

    print(f"[5] final output cells: {count_df['cell'].nunique()}")
    print(f"[5] final zero-variant cells: {(count_df['n_variants'] == 0).sum()}")
    print(f"[5] final cells with variants: {(count_df['n_variants'] > 0).sum()}")
    print(f"[5] reads NA count: {count_df['reads'].isna().sum()}")

    # Export per-cell variant counts
    out_count = (
        f"{BASE_DIR}/{sample}/cell_snv/"
        f"{sample}_scSNV_cell_variant_count_validcell_min2c.tsv"
    )

    count_df.to_csv(
        out_count,
        sep="\t",
        index=False
    )

    all_count.append(count_df)

    print(f"[OUT] long:  {out_long}")
    print(f"[OUT] count: {out_count}")

# Combine results across all melanoma samples
df_all = pd.concat(all_count, ignore_index=True)

out_all = (
    f"{BASE_DIR}/"
    "scSNV_variant_count_vs_reads_input_validcell_min2c.tsv"
)

df_all.to_csv(out_all, sep="\t", index=False)
```

## cellsnp-lite

cellsnp-lite is an efficient tool for SNP genotyping and allele-specific read counting from bulk and single-cell sequencing data, including DNA-seq, RNA-seq, and ATAC-seq. It supports both 10x Genomics and Smart-seq2 datasets.

Four running modes are available:

- Mode 1a: Genotype predefined SNPs using pooled sequencing data.
- Mode 1b: Genotype predefined SNPs at the single-cell level.
- Mode 2a: Discover SNPs de novo using pooled sequencing data.
- Mode 2b: Discover SNPs de novo at the single-cell level.

**Reference:** [cellsnp-lite (Bioinformatics, 2021)](https://cellsnp-lite.readthedocs.io/en/latest/index.html)

</details>
  
<details>
<summary>10x pooled level</summary>

**calling:**

step1: run cellsnp-lite 2b mode

```{bash,eval=FALSE}
export PATH=$PATH:/home/tantingting/scmut/tools
chmod +x /home/tantingting/scmut/tools/memusg

# ================= Parameter Configuration =================
# Input directory (parent directory of Cell Ranger outputs)
IN_DIR="/mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut/bam/2_melanoma_scRNA"

# Output directory
OUT_DIR="/mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut/vcf/2_melanoma_scRNA/cellsnp"

# Reference genome
REF_GENOME="/home/tantingting/scmut/ref/bwa_ref/genome.fa"

# Number of threads
THREADS=16
# ===========================================================

# Create the main output directory
mkdir -p "$OUT_DIR"

echo "Starting cellsnp-lite analysis (Mode 2b: De novo calling)..."
echo "Reference genome: $REF_GENOME"

# Iterate over all samples
for sample_path in ${IN_DIR}/*_SRR*; do

    # Check whether the path is a directory
    [ -d "$sample_path" ] || continue

    # Extract sample name
    sample_name=$(basename "$sample_path")

    echo "--------------------------------------------------"
    echo "Processing sample: $sample_name"

    # Locate the BAM file (standard Cell Ranger output)
    BAM="${sample_path}/outs/possorted_genome_bam.bam"

    if [ ! -f "$BAM" ]; then
        echo "Warning: BAM file not found. Skipping sample $sample_name"
        continue
    fi

    # Set sample-specific output directory
    SAMPLE_OUT="${OUT_DIR}/${sample_name}_2b"
    mkdir -p "$SAMPLE_OUT"

    # Skip samples with existing output files
    if [ -f "$SAMPLE_OUT/cellSNP.base.vcf.gz" ]; then
        echo "Warning: Output file already exists. Skipping: $SAMPLE_OUT"
        continue
    fi

    # Run cellsnp-lite
    # --cellTAG None: Disable cell barcode-based processing
    # and perform pooled de novo SNP calling
    memusg -t cellsnp-lite \
        -s "$BAM" \
        -O "$SAMPLE_OUT" \
        -p $THREADS \
        --minMAF 0.1 \
        --minCOUNT 20 \
        --refseq "$REF_GENOME" \
        --cellTAG None \
        --UMItag UB \
        --gzip \
        --genotype

    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "Sample $sample_name: cellsnp-lite completed successfully."
    else
        echo "Error: cellsnp-lite failed for sample $sample_name!"
    fi
done

echo "=================================================="
echo "All tasks completed."
```

```{bash,eval=FALSE}
CELL_BASE=$1

echo "======================================"

for SAMPLE_DIR in "${CELL_BASE}"/*_2b; do

    [ -d "${SAMPLE_DIR}" ] || continue

    sample=$(basename "${SAMPLE_DIR}")
	base_sample=${sample%_2b}

    if [[ "${sample}" == "cell_variant_count" ]] || \
       [[ "${sample}" == "nouse" ]]; then
        continue
    fi

    INPUT_VCF="${SAMPLE_DIR}/cellSNP.cells.vcf.gz"

    if [ ! -f "${INPUT_VCF}" ]; then
        echo "[WARN] Skip ${sample}: cellSNP.cells.vcf.gz not found"
        continue
    fi

    echo
    echo "======================================"
    echo "Processing ${sample}"
    echo "======================================"
	
	mkdir -p "${CELL_BASE}/filter_2b"
	OUTPUT_VCF="${CELL_BASE}/filter_2b/${base_sample}_PASS.vcf.gz"
	
	if [ ! -f "${OUTPUT_VCF}" ]; then

		bcftools annotate \
			--rename-chrs "${CHR_MAP}" \
			"${INPUT_VCF}" -Ou | \
		bcftools view \
			-i '
				INFO/DP>10 &&
				INFO/AD/INFO/DP>0.05 &&
				GT!="0/0"
			' \
			-Oz \
			-o "${OUTPUT_VCF}"

		bcftools index -t "${OUTPUT_VCF}"
	fi
	NVAR=$(bcftools view -H "${OUTPUT_VCF}" | wc -l)
	echo "[INFO] ${sample}: ${NVAR} variants kept"
done

echo
echo "======================================"
echo "All samples finished"
echo "======================================"
```

**filtering:**

```{python,eval=FALSE}
import gzip
import os
import csv
from collections import defaultdict

samples = ["Acral1_SRR20791206", "Acral2_SRR20791205", "Acral3pre_SRR20791203", "Acral3post_SRR20791202", "Acral4_SRR20791201", "Cutaneous1_SRR20791198", "Cutaneous1Lym_SRR20791196", "Cutaneous2_SRR20791197"]
CELL_BASE = "/mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut/vcf/2_melanoma_scRNA/cellsnp"
OUT_BASE = "/mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut/vcf/2_melanoma_scRNA/cellsnp/cell_variant_count"
os.makedirs(OUT_BASE, exist_ok=True)

def parse_info(info):
    d = {}
    for x in info.split(";"):
        if "=" in x:
            k, v = x.split("=", 1)
            d[k] = v
    return d

def get_pass_sites_from_base(base_vcf):
    """
    First-round filtering:
    - Chromosomes 1–22
    - INFO/DP > 10
    - INFO/AD / INFO/DP > 0.05
    """
    pass_sites = set()
    with gzip.open(base_vcf, "rt") as f:
        for line in f:
            if line.startswith("#"):
                continue
            arr = line.rstrip("\n").split("\t")
            chrom, pos, _id, ref, alt, qual, filt, info = arr[:8]
            if chrom not in set(map(str, range(1, 23))):
                continue
            info_d = parse_info(info)
            try:
                dp = int(info_d.get("DP", 0))
                ad = int(info_d.get("AD", 0))
            except ValueError:
                continue
            if dp <= 10:
                continue
            af = ad / dp if dp > 0 else 0
            if af <= 0.05:
                continue
            site_id = f"{chrom}:{pos}:{ref}:{alt}"
            pass_sites.add(site_id)
    return pass_sites

def count_cell_variants(sample):
    sample_dir = os.path.join(CELL_BASE, f"{sample}_1a")
    base_vcf = os.path.join(sample_dir, "cellSNP.base.vcf.gz")
    cell_vcf = os.path.join(sample_dir, "cellSNP.cells.vcf.gz")
    if not os.path.exists(base_vcf):
        print(f"[WARN] missing base VCF: {base_vcf}")
        return
    if not os.path.exists(cell_vcf):
        print(f"[WARN] missing cell VCF: {cell_vcf}")
        return
    print(f"\n===== {sample} =====")
    pass_sites = get_pass_sites_from_base(base_vcf)
    print(f"{sample}: first-round retained sites = {len(pass_sites)}")
    cell_barcodes = []
    cell_variant_count = defaultdict(int)
    cell_variant_ids = defaultdict(list)
    n_total_sites = 0
    n_round1_sites = 0
    n_round2_sites = 0
    with gzip.open(cell_vcf, "rt") as f:
        for line in f:
            line = line.rstrip("\n")
            if line.startswith("##"):
                continue
            if line.startswith("#CHROM"):
                header = line.split("\t")
                cell_barcodes = header[9:]
                continue
            arr = line.split("\t")
            n_total_sites += 1
            chrom, pos, _id, ref, alt = arr[0], arr[1], arr[2], arr[3], arr[4]
            if chrom not in set(map(str, range(1, 23))):
                continue
            site_id = f"{chrom}:{pos}:{ref}:{alt}"
            if site_id not in pass_sites:  # Count variants only at sites retained after first-round filtering
                continue
            n_round1_sites += 1

            fmt = arr[8].split(":")  # Determine the positions of GT, AD, and DP fields
            try:
                gt_idx = fmt.index("GT")
                ad_idx = fmt.index("AD")
                dp_idx = fmt.index("DP")
            except ValueError:
                continue
            sample_fields = arr[9:]
            cells_with_reads = 0
            cells_with_alt = 0
            alt_cells = []
            for i, g in enumerate(sample_fields):
                if g == "." or g.startswith(".:"):
                    continue
                parts = g.split(":")
                if len(parts) <= max(gt_idx, ad_idx, dp_idx):
                    continue  # Prevent incorrect indexing of GT, AD, and DP fields
                try:
                    gt = parts[gt_idx]
                    ad = int(parts[ad_idx])
                    dp = int(parts[dp_idx])
                except ValueError:
                    continue
                if dp > 0:
                    cells_with_reads += 1

                # Count a variant only when GT is not 0/0 and AD > 0
                if ad > 0 and gt not in {"0/0", "0|0", "./.", "."}:
                    cells_with_alt += 1
                    alt_cells.append(i)

            if cells_with_reads >= 5 and cells_with_alt >= 2:
                n_round2_sites += 1
                for i in alt_cells:
                    cell = cell_barcodes[i]
                    cell_variant_count[cell] += 1
                    cell_variant_ids[cell].append(site_id)

    out_file = os.path.join(
        OUT_BASE,
        f"{sample}_cellSNP_filtered_cell_variant_count.tsv"
    )
    with open(out_file, "w", newline="") as out:
        writer = csv.writer(out, delimiter="\t")
        writer.writerow(["sample", "cell", "n_variants"])
        for cell in cell_barcodes:
            writer.writerow([
                sample,
                cell,
                cell_variant_count.get(cell, 0)
            ])

    detail_file = os.path.join(OUT_BASE,f"{sample}_cellSNP_filtered_cell_variant_detail.tsv")
    with open(detail_file, "w", newline="") as out:
        writer = csv.writer(out, delimiter="\t")
        writer.writerow(["sample", "cell", "variant_id"])
        for cell in cell_barcodes:
            for variant_id in cell_variant_ids.get(cell, []):
                writer.writerow([sample,cell,variant_id])

    print(f"{sample}: total cell VCF sites scanned = {n_total_sites}")
    print(f"{sample}: matched first-round sites = {n_round1_sites}")
    print(f"{sample}: final second-round sites = {n_round2_sites}")
    print(f"{sample}: output = {out_file}")

for sample in samples:
    count_cell_variants(sample)
```

**filtering:**

```{bash,eval=FALSE}
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Usage: bash split_cellsnp_sample.sh BC01
#        bash split_cellsnp_sample.sh PT081

SAMPLE=${1:-}
MANIFEST=/mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut_smart/bam/star_qc_unique_ge10k_scrna_sample_wes.tsv
CHR_MAP=/home/tantingting/scmut/ref/bwa_ref/chr_map22.txt
BASE=/mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut_smart/vcf

# Determine cohort and output directory
if [[ $SAMPLE == PT* ]]; then
    COHORT=1_TNBC
    OUTDIR=${BASE}/1_TNBC_scRNA/cellsnp_rerun/per_srr_vcf
    mkdir -p "$OUTDIR"
elif [[ $SAMPLE == BC* ]]; then
    COHORT=2_BRCA
    OUTDIR=${BASE}/2_BRCA_scRNA/cellsnp_rerun/per_srr_vcf
    mkdir -p "$OUTDIR"
else
    echo "[ERROR] Unknown sample: $SAMPLE"
    exit 1
fi

# Define input VCF
INPUT_DIR=${BASE}/${COHORT}_scRNA/cellsnp_rerun/${SAMPLE}
INPUT_VCF=${INPUT_DIR}/cellSNP.cells.vcf.gz

if [[ ! -f "$INPUT_VCF" ]]; then
    echo "[ERROR] Cannot find: $INPUT_VCF"
    exit 1
fi

echo "======================================="
echo "Sample : $SAMPLE"
echo "VCF    : $INPUT_VCF"
echo "Output : $OUTDIR"
echo "======================================="

# Extract SRR IDs and generate individual cell VCFs
awk -v sample="$SAMPLE" '
NR>1 && $2==sample {print $1}
' "$MANIFEST" |
while read SRR; do
    echo "[$SRR]"
    OUT=${OUTDIR}/${SRR}.cellSNP.filtered.vcf.gz

    # Skip previously completed files
    if [[ -s "$OUT" && -s "${OUT}.tbi" ]]; then
        echo "  already exists"
        continue
    fi

    # Extract and filter variants for each cell
    bcftools view \
        -s "$SRR" \
        -Ou \
        "$INPUT_VCF" |
    bcftools view \
        -i 'FMT/GT!="0/0" && FMT/GT!="0|0" && FMT/GT!="." && FMT/GT!="./." && FMT/GT!=".|." && FMT/DP>10 && FMT/AD/FMT/DP>0.05' \
        -Ou |
    bcftools annotate \
        --rename-chrs "$CHR_MAP" \
        -Oz \
        -o "$OUT"

    tabix -f -p vcf "$OUT"
    echo "  done"
done

echo "Finished: $SAMPLE"
```

## SAMtools

SAMtools/BCFtools provides a pileup-based framework for identifying SNVs and indels from aligned sequencing reads.

**Reference:** [SAMtools/BCFtools (GigaScience, 2021)](https://www.htslib.org/)

</details>
  
<details>
<summary>10x pooled level</summary>
  
**calling:**
  
```{bash,eval=FALSE}
export PATH=/home/tantingting/scmut/tools:$PATH
ref_genome="/home/tantingting/scmut/ref/bwa_ref/genome.fa"
samples=("Acral1_SRR20791206" "Acral2_SRR20791205" "Acral3pre_SRR20791203" "Acral3post_SRR20791202" "Acral4_SRR20791201" "Cutaneous1_SRR20791198" "Cutaneous1Lym_SRR20791196" "Cutaneous2_SRR20791197" )

for sample in "${samples[@]}"
do
    BAM="/mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut/bam/2_melanoma_scRNA/${sample}/outs/possorted_genome_bam.bam"
    OUT_DIR="/mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut/vcf/2_melanoma_scRNA/samtools_pool/${sample}"
    VCF_GZ="${OUT_DIR}/${sample}.vcf.gz"
    echo "Processing sample: ${sample}"
    mkdir -p "${OUT_DIR}"
	memusg -t bash -c '
		bcftools mpileup -Q 20 -q 20 -A -x -Ou --threads 16 -f "'"$ref_genome"'" "'"$BAM"'" |
		bcftools call --threads 16 -mv -Oz -o "'"$VCF_GZ"'"
	'
done
```

**filtering:**

```{bash,eval=FALSE}
POOL_DIR=$1
REF="/home/tantingting/scmut/ref/bwa_ref/genome.fa"
OUT_DIR="${POOL_DIR}/filter"
mkdir -p "${OUT_DIR}"

echo "======================================"
echo "Input directory : ${POOL_DIR}"
echo "Output directory: ${OUT_DIR}"
echo "======================================"

for SAMPLE_DIR in "${POOL_DIR}"/*; do
    sample=$(basename "${SAMPLE_DIR}")
    # Skip the filter directory itself
    if [ "${sample}" = "filter" ]; then
        continue
    fi

    INPUT_VCF="${SAMPLE_DIR}/${sample}.vcf.gz"

    if [ ! -f "${INPUT_VCF}" ]; then
        echo "[WARN] Skip ${sample}: ${INPUT_VCF} not found"
        continue
    fi

    OUTPUT_VCF="${OUT_DIR}/${sample}_PASS.vcf.gz"

    if [ ! -f "${INPUT_VCF}.tbi" ] && [ ! -f "${INPUT_VCF}.csi" ]; then
        echo "[INFO] Indexing ${sample} ..."
        bcftools index -t "${INPUT_VCF}"
    fi

    echo
    echo "======================================"
    echo "Processing ${sample}"
    echo "======================================"

    bcftools view \
        -r chr1,chr2,chr3,chr4,chr5,chr6,chr7,chr8,chr9,chr10,chr11,chr12,chr13,chr14,chr15,chr16,chr17,chr18,chr19,chr20,chr21,chr22,chrX,chrY,chrM \
        "${INPUT_VCF}" | \
    bcftools norm \
        -f "${REF}" \
        -m -both | \
    bcftools view \
        -i '
            FMT/GT!="0/0" &&
            QUAL>20 &&
            (
                (INFO/DP4[2]+INFO/DP4[3]) /
                (INFO/DP4[0]+INFO/DP4[1]+INFO/DP4[2]+INFO/DP4[3])
            ) > 0.05 &&
            (
                (TYPE="snp"  && INFO/DP>10) ||
                (TYPE!="snp" && INFO/DP>15)
            )
        ' \
        -Oz \
        -o "${OUTPUT_VCF}"

    bcftools index -t "${OUTPUT_VCF}"
    NVAR=$(bcftools view -H "${OUTPUT_VCF}" | wc -l)
    echo "[INFO] ${sample}: ${NVAR} variants kept"

done

echo
echo "======================================"
echo "All samples finished"
echo "Results saved in:"
echo "${OUT_DIR}"
echo "======================================"
```

## Varscan2

VarScan2 identifies SNVs and indels from sequencing data using read depth, base quality, variant allele frequency, and statistical significance to distinguish variants from sequencing errors.

The workflow included:

- Preprocessing: Generate nucleotide-level pileup files from aligned BAM files using `samtools mpileup`.
- Variant calling: Detect SNVs and indels using VarScan2 `mpileup2snp` and `mpileup2indel`, respectively.

**Reference:** [VarScan2 (Genome Research, 2012)](https://github.com/dkoboldt/varscan)

</details>
  
<details>
<summary>10x pooled level</summary>
  
**calling:**
  
```{bash,eval=FALSE}
export PATH=$PATH:/home/tantingting/scmut/tools
chmod +x /home/tantingting/scmut/tools/memusg
VARSCAN_JAR="/home/tantingting/scmut/tools/VarScan.v2.4.6.jar"
REF_GENOME="/home/tantingting/scmut/ref/bwa_ref/genome.fa"
IN_DIR="/mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut/bam/2_melanoma_scRNA"
OUT_DIR="/mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut/vcf/2_melanoma_scRNA/varscan2_pool"
# ===========================================================

# Create the output directory
if [ ! -d "$OUT_DIR" ]; then
    mkdir -p "$OUT_DIR"
fi

# Iterate over all samples
for sample_path in ${IN_DIR}/*_SRR*; do

    # Check whether the path is a directory
    [ -d "$sample_path" ] || continue
    # Extract sample name
    sample_name=$(basename "$sample_path")
    # Locate the BAM file
    BAM="${sample_path}/outs/possorted_genome_bam.bam"
    if [ ! -f "$BAM" ]; then
        BAM="${sample_path}/possorted_genome_bam.bam"
    fi
    if [ ! -f "$BAM" ]; then
        echo "Warning: BAM file not found -> $sample_name. Skipping."
        continue
    fi

    # Create sample-specific output directory
    SAMPLE_OUT="${OUT_DIR}/${sample_name}"
    mkdir -p "$SAMPLE_OUT"

    # Define the output VCF filename
    VCF="${SAMPLE_OUT}/${sample_name}.vcf"

    echo "--------------------------------------------------"
    echo "Processing sample: ${sample_name}"

    CMD_STRING="samtools mpileup -Q 20 -q 20 -f $REF_GENOME $BAM | \
    java -jar $VARSCAN_JAR mpileup2snp \
        --min-coverage 10 \
        --output-vcf 1 \
        --strand-filter 0 \
        --p-value 0.05 \
        --min-avg-qual 20 \
        --min-var-freq 0.05 \
        > $VCF"

    memusg -t bash -c "$CMD_STRING"

    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "VarScan2 completed. Compressing VCF..."
        gzip -f "$VCF"
        echo "Output file: ${VCF}.gz"
    else
        echo "Error: VarScan2 failed for sample ${sample_name}!"
    fi

done

echo "=================================================="
echo "All tasks completed."
```

```{bash,eval=FALSE}
export PATH=/home/tantingting/scmut/tools:$PATH
dataset="$1"
batch_file="$2"

ref_genome="/home/tantingting/scmut/ref/bwa_ref/genome.fa"
varscan_jar="/home/tantingting/scmut/tools/VarScan.v2.4.6.jar"

bam_dir="/mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut_smart/bam/${dataset}/md_bam"
out_base="/mnt/storage/tantingting/scmut_smart/vcf/${dataset}/varscan2"
filter_dir="${out_base}/filter"
chr_list="chr1,chr2,chr3,chr4,chr5,chr6,chr7,chr8,chr9,chr10,chr11,chr12,chr13,chr14,chr15,chr16,chr17,chr18,chr19,chr20,chr21,chr22,chrX,chrY,chrM"

mkdir -p "$out_base" "$filter_dir"

while read -r sample; do
    [[ -z "$sample" || "$sample" =~ ^# ]] && continue

    bam="${bam_dir}/${sample}_sortmd.bam"
    sample_out="${out_base}/${sample}"
    raw_vcf="${sample_out}/${sample}.varscan2.vcf"
    raw_vcfgz="${raw_vcf}.gz"
    final_vcf="${filter_dir}/${sample}.varscan2_PASS.vcf.gz"

    echo "========== ${dataset} | ${sample} =========="
    [[ ! -f "$bam" ]] && echo "[WARN] Missing $bam" && continue
    mkdir -p "$sample_out"

    if [[ ! -f "$raw_vcfgz" || ! -f "${raw_vcfgz}.tbi" ]]; then
        echo "[CALL] $sample"

        memusg -t bash -c '
          samtools mpileup -Q 20 -q 20 -f "'"$ref_genome"'" "'"$bam"'" | \
          java -jar "'"$varscan_jar"'" mpileup2snp \
            --min-coverage 10 \
            --output-vcf 1 \
            --strand-filter 0 \
            --p-value 0.05 \
            --min-avg-qual 20 \
            --min-var-freq 0.05 \
            > "'"$raw_vcf"'"
        '

        [[ ! -f "$raw_vcf" ]] && echo "[ERROR] CALL failed: $sample" && continue
        bgzip -f "$raw_vcf"
        tabix -f -p vcf "$raw_vcfgz"
    else
        echo "[SKIP CALL] $sample"
    fi

    if [[ ! -f "$final_vcf" || ! -f "${final_vcf}.tbi" ]]; then
        echo "[FILTER] $sample"

        bcftools view -r "$chr_list" "$raw_vcfgz" | \
        bcftools norm -f "$ref_genome" -m -both | \
        bcftools view -i '
          FMT/GT!="0/0" &&
          FMT/DP>10 &&
          (FMT/AD / (FMT/RD + FMT/AD)) > 0.05
        ' -Oz -o "$final_vcf"

        tabix -f -p vcf "$final_vcf"

        echo "[INFO] Filtered VCF: $final_vcf"
        echo "[INFO] Kept sites: $(bcftools view -H "$final_vcf" | wc -l)"
    else
        echo "[SKIP FILTER] $sample"
        echo "[INFO] Kept sites: $(bcftools view -H "$final_vcf" | wc -l)"
    fi

    echo "[DONE] $sample"

done < "$batch_file"
```
